scores.notes: Sherlock Holmes (standing on the bed at left and bending to tap the pavement in a top hat at right) has the same tall, lean build, gaunt angular clean-shaven face, prominent nose, and dark hair.
Daniel (standing among the lions at left and gesturing before the king at right) is the same older man with short cropped grey-white hair, neat grey-white beard, tanned skin, and medium build.

The March Hare's house behind the tea table conflicts architecturally: left shows an ivy-covered red-brick cottage with a gabled porch and the tree trunk on the left, while right shows a plain pale stucco house with rectangular sash windows and the tree trunk on the right.

Sherlock Holmes (at the open doorway on the left and stepping up to the pawnbroker's door on the right) matches closely in tall lean build, receding combed-back dark hair, gaunt cheekbones, prominent nose, and clean-shaven face.

Moses (walking center-front through the parted sea with a staff at left and seated on a rock with raised arms at right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, full white beard, weathered skin, and medium build.

Moses (standing on the cliff edge at left and seated on the stone between Aaron and Hur at right) shares the same flowing shoulder-length white hair, full white beard, aged facial features, and build.
Dr. Watson (seated in the armchair at left and entering the room in a bowler hat at right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with a thick dark moustache, square jawline, and fair complexion.

Jesus (calling toward Lazarus's tomb at left and seated by the charcoal fire on the shore at right) has the same wavy shoulder-length dark brown hair, full trimmed dark beard, olive skin, and facial profile.

Moses (in profile on the rocky ledge at left and walking at the head of the Israelites at right) is consistently depicted as the same elderly man with flowing white hair, full white beard, and sturdy build.

Moses is clearly visible seated on the stone at left, but in the right image he stands small in the middle distance on the cliff with his back turned away from the viewer, hiding his face and preventing identity comparison.

Alice (drinking from the bottle in the hall at left and holding a flamingo on the croquet-ground at right) is the same young fair-skinned girl with long wavy light-brown hair, headband, and matching facial features and age.
Both images plausibly depict the same dry sandy-and-rocky seabed corridor cut between towering turquoise-blue walls of water, with compatible reddish coastal cliffs along the left shore.
